Two CD8 signatures act primary confirm scores, disagreements flagged ambiguous. title: Data Processing, Integration, and Clustering
text: ProcessSeuratLOG() runs complete Seurat v5 LogNormalize workflow. : splits RNA assay one layer per batch (batch_col); log-normalises data selects 2,000 variable features; removes TCR/BCR V(D)J genes (tcr_bcr_patterns) variable features, clustering reflects cell phenotype rather clonotype; scales data regressing vars_to_regress; optionally boosts variance lineage markers (boost_genes, boost_multiplier), helps separate look-alike populations CD8 T NK cells; runs PCA, saves elbow plot suggests number PCs; integrates layers Harmony, RPCA, CCA FastMNN, shrinking k.weight, k.anchor, k.filter k.score automatically batch small; re-joins layers.  Interactive use. interactive_mode = TRUE interactive R session, function pauses PCA step can choose number PCs integration k parameters elbow plot.

text: droplet-based scRNA-seq, transcripts released lysed cells form “soup” captured every droplet. ambient RNA makes highly expressed genes, monocyte LYZ S100A8/9 haemoglobin, appear unrelated cell types. SoupX estimates soup profile empty droplets, estimates contamination fraction (rho) per sample, subtracts soup cell. OHMmy wraps SoupX multi-sample pipeline reads Cell Ranger output directories directly:

title: Ambient RNA Decontamination with SoupX
text: estimate_contamination() sets clusters channel, runs SoupX::autoEstCont() adjusts counts. contamination fraction can raised purpose mulFac, given percentage points added estimated rho: manual = FALSE (default): mulFac added every sample; manual = TRUE: mulFac added samples listed manual_contam. autoEstCont() estimates 6 % contamination. selective override raises PBMC_B. estimated soup profile shows genes dominate ambient pool: create_final_seurat() turns corrected channels new Seurat objects (min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, mitoPercent column):
code: est_auto <- estimate_contamination(   soup_list, seurat_list, counts$filtered, samples,   mulFac = 0, methods = "subtraction" )  # PBMC_B looks noisier: add 5 percentage points to its rho only est_manual <- estimate_contamination(   soup_list, seurat_list, counts$filtered, samples,   mulFac = 5, manual = TRUE, manual_contam = "PBMC_B" ) get_rho <- function(soup_objs) sapply(soup_objs, function(sc) unique(sc$metaData$rho)) rbind(auto = get_rho(est_auto$soup_list_all), selective = get_rho(est_manual$soup_list_all)) #>           PBMC_A PBMC_B #> auto       0.058  0.063 #> selective  0.058  0.113 sp <- est_auto$soup_list_all$PBMC_A$soupProfile head(sp[order(-sp$est), ], 10) #>                est counts #> MALAT1 0.025139447   3547 #> B2M    0.019419815   2740 #> TMSB4X 0.018952039   2674 #> RPL10  0.014061647   1984 #> RPL13  0.011935390   1684 #> RPL13A 0.011786552   1663 #> FTL    0.011772377   1661 #> RPS2   0.010149334   1432 #> RPS6   0.009773695   1379 #> RPS18  0.008894842   1255 clean_list <- create_final_seurat(est_auto$soup_list_all, samples) clean_list #> $PBMC_A #> An object of class Seurat  #> 12337 features across 1326 samples within 1 assay  #> Active assay: RNA (12337 features, 0 variable features) #>  1 layer present: counts #>  #> $PBMC_B #> An object of class Seurat  #> 12305 features across 1374 samples within 1 assay  #> Active assay: RNA (12305 features, 0 variable features) #>  1 layer present: counts

text: Loading, channel creation clustering depend contamination settings. prepare_soupx_inputs() therefore bundles runs . run_soupx_post_clustering() takes bundle performs estimation, correction Seurat creation, parameter sweeps cheap. sweep multiFac record many UMIs remain:
code: prep <- prepare_soupx_inputs(cr$filtered_dir, cr$raw_dir) names(prep) #> [1] "sample_names"          "counts_lists"          "soup_list"             #> [4] "seurat_for_clustering" "manual_contam" sweep <- lapply(c(0, 5, 10, 20), function(mf) {   res <- run_soupx_post_clustering(prep, multiFac = mf, methods = "subtraction")   data.frame(     multiFac = mf,     sample   = names(res$final_seurat),     rho      = get_rho(res$soup_objects),     umis     = sapply(res$final_seurat, function(x) sum(x$nCount_RNA))   ) }) sweep <- do.call(rbind, sweep) raw_umis <- sapply(counts$filtered, sum) sweep$pct_removed <- 100 * (1 - sweep$umis / raw_umis[sweep$sample]) sweep #>         multiFac sample   rho    umis pct_removed #> PBMC_A         0 PBMC_A 0.058 3007505    5.942251 #> PBMC_B         0 PBMC_B 0.063 2987837    6.428975 #> PBMC_A1        5 PBMC_A 0.108 2847866   10.934856 #> PBMC_B1        5 PBMC_B 0.113 2828206   11.428188 #> PBMC_A2       10 PBMC_A 0.158 2688106   15.931245 #> PBMC_B2       10 PBMC_B 0.163 2668570   16.427559 #> PBMC_A3       20 PBMC_A 0.258 2367362   25.962304 #> PBMC_B3       20 PBMC_B 0.263 2347818   26.472650  ggplot(sweep, aes(rho, pct_removed, colour = sample)) +   geom_line() + geom_point(size = 2.5) +   labs(x = "Contamination fraction (rho)", y = "% of UMIs removed", colour = NULL) +   theme_bw()

code: library(Seurat) library(OHMmy)  # --------------------------------------------------------- # 1.
